      "snippet": "Because “self-monitoring” only matters if it runs when you are most likely to be wrong — and that moment is boot/activation.
If you don’t wire it into boot, what happens in practice is:

a capability can be present on disk but not actually active

Nano can bypass the chokepoint (or the chokepoint can be missing) and you won’t notice

learning/event ledgers can stop updating and you won’t notice

you get “stupid shit lately,” and the system has no automatic evidence trail to prove what broke

Boo"
